name: CopyButton
summary: Compact icon-button that writes a value to the clipboard and flashes a confirmation. Three forms: ghost (the default — minimal, paired with CodeBlock / token / API key surfaces), pill (label + icon, the standalone form), and inline (a leading-icon row that the consumer wraps around a value chip). Announces success via aria-live='polite'.

label.description: Visible label on pill / inline variants. Defaults to 'Copy'.

onCopied.description: Fires after the clipboard write resolves.

rules: Ghost variant requires aria-label='Copy {what}'. Pill variant carries a visible label.
Success state announces via aria-live='polite' with the successLabel.
The icon swaps Copy → Check on success and resets after 1.6 s.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion: replace the swap animation with an instant flip.

do: Default to ghost when paired with a CodeBlock or a token value.
Use pill (label + icon) as a standalone affordance ('Copy API key').
Pair with a Tooltip on ghost variants to name the action on hover.
Auto-reset after 1.6 s — don't leave the success state pinned.
dont: Don't render CopyButton without a value.
Don't paint the success state in danger red.
Don't combine ghost variant with a separate visible label — use pill if you want a label.
Don't use CopyButton for non-copy actions ('Download', 'Share'). Use the right semantic affordance.

changelog.note: Initial CopyButton contract. Three variants, three sizes, aria-live success announce.
